technical.summary: Strong bullish structure with golden crosses and price above all MAs, but overbought oscillators (RSI 77.59, Stoch 82.2) and weak ADX (24.11) limit entry conviction; better suited for pullback entry or confirmation of momentum continuation.

fundamental.summary: AEE shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 71 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional activity and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (378.4) combined with flat yield curve and negative macro score (-3) creates severely unfavourable conditions; earnings in 71 days adds moderate event risk but is secondary to acute market stress.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden crosses (EMA/SMA 9/21), price above all major MAs, supertrend bullish, and OBV rising volume create strong technical structure with extreme fear sentiment (10/100) offering contrarian entry opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (RSI 77.59, Stoch 82.2), weak ADX trend confirmation (24.11), crisis VIX regime (378.4), unfavourable macro (-3), zero fundamental support, and price not above 200 EMA/50 SMA create excessive near-term pullback risk that outweighs technical setup strength.
